trades.desc: The Member held stock in Cano Health, through Primary Care (ITC) Holdings, Inc. (a private equity holding company of the Cano Health entities prior to this date), which is reported on previous filings. On June 3, 2021, through a SPAC transaction, a public acquisition company purchased all equity of Cano Health entities. The transaction resulted in an exchange of non-publicly traded shares for Class A shares on February 14, 2022.
